title: Das erotische Imago II

description.main: Das erotische Imago II is the collector Uwe Scheid's pocket-format survey of the nude photograph from 1900 to the mid-1980s, number 485 in Harenberg's series Die bibliophilen Taschenbücher. It follows his 1984 volume on the nude in early photography.
description.extended:
Das erotische Imago II is the collector Uwe Scheid's pocket-format survey of the nude photograph from 1900 to the mid-1980s, number 485 in Harenberg's series Die bibliophilen Taschenbücher.

The subtitle is Das Aktphoto von 1900 bis heute. The book follows Scheid's 1984 volume in the same series, Das erotische Imago (Nr. 449), which covered the nineteenth-century nude. After a short introduction the pages are given to pictures, most of them full page and some in colour. Six chapters sort them: the early colour nude, Freikörperkultur and the sun cult of the 1920s, the pictorial nude, new directions in erotic photography, glamour photography, and the erotic image of 1986. A reading list closes the book. Like the rest of the series it is a glued softcover, 17.5 by 12 cm. Harenberg reprinted it in 1988 and 1992, and Orbis issued a licensed edition in 1999.

Scheid (1944-2000) was a merchant in Überherrn-Berus in the Saarland. He built one of the largest private collections of erotic photography, several thousand daguerreotypes and prints from the 1840s to the 1940s, with work by Wilhelm von Gloeden, Man Ray, Edward Steichen and František Drtikol. He published it again in Die erotische Daguerreotypie (1989) and in Taschen's 1000 Nudes (1994).
description.artist_bio: Uwe Scheid (1944-2000) was a merchant in Überherrn-Berus, Saarland, and one of the world's leading collectors of erotic photography, holding several thousand daguerreotypes and prints from c. 1840 to 1940. Member of the Deutsche Fotografische Akademie, the European Society for the History of Photography, Club Daguerre and the Daguerreian Society. Publications: Das erotische Imago (Harenberg, 1984), Das erotische Imago II (Harenberg, 1986), Die erotische Daguerreotypie (Kunstverlag Weingarten, 1989), 1000 Nudes (Taschen, 1994, with Hans-Michael Koetzle).

notes: Shelf: Mollino / Richardson. Die bibliophilen Taschenbücher Nr. 485; subtitle on the title page: Das Aktphoto von 1900 bis heute. First printing 1986 (190 pp.); 2nd printing 1988, 3rd printing 1992 (189 pp.), later printings under the Harenberg Edition imprint; Orbis, Munich licensed edition 1999. Companion to Das erotische Imago, Der Akt in frühen Photographien (Nr. 449, 1984). Printing of this copy not verified.
